title: Test Docker/native environments
description: Registry of environments referenced by scenarios.yaml's `envs:` — base images plus layered `from:`-chain variants, each optionally carrying WhenSpec-style `attributes:` used by the test-generation pipeline to decide which environments satisfy a feature's `when:` conditions.

attributes.description: WhenSpec-style attribute facts about this environment (`os.*`/`plat.*` keys, matching the grammar used by `_options.method.*.when`/`_dependencies.*.when`/`_system_requirements.platforms` in metadata.yaml), used by the test generator to decide which environments satisfy a given `when:` clause. String values are exact facts; array values mean "any of these" (e.g. multiple supported architectures).

dockerfile.description: Shell commands layered on top of the base/parent image in a generated RUN heredoc (retry() helper already in scope).

runFragmentPath.description: Normalized POSIX path, relative to test/envs, to a regular non-symlink file containing LF-only UTF-8 shell commands and no NUL bytes. Supported content is embedded without newline normalization in a generated RUN heredoc.

resolveAttempts.description: Outer Docker build attempt budget. Use 1 when the build fragment already owns bounded retries; otherwise omit for the default of 3.

baseEnvironment.description: A root environment with its own image (no `from:`) — must declare `attributes:` since there is no parent to inherit from.

image.description: Docker image reference (Linux) or `macos-*` pseudo-image (native GHA macOS runner, no Docker).

env_vars.description: Environment variables exported for every scenario running against this environment.

clean_path.description: macOS only: strip the GHA runner's pre-installed PATH down to the system baseline before running scenarios.

path_prepend.description: macOS only: colon-separated PATH entries prepended after `clean_path` stripping.

lib_test_profile.description: Explicit capability role when this environment is used by the isolated library-test matrix.

variantEnvironment.description: An environment layered on top of another via `from:`. Inherits the parent's `attributes:` (flattened transitively through `from:` chains); only needs its own `attributes:` when it genuinely changes OS identity (e.g. a `+toolchain` layer never does).

from.description: Key of the parent environment this one is layered on top of.

attributes.description: Optional attribute overrides/additions merged on top of the parent's (flattened) attributes.

lib_test_profile.description: Explicit capability role when this environment is used by the isolated library-test matrix.
